newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks open firmer, follow New York up.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks open firmer, follow New York up.

text.p: * Toronto stocks firmed in dull trading at Monday's open, following New York higher. * Traders eying slew of U.S. data this week. * 17.8 million shares traded worth C$288 million.
Toronto stocks firmed in dull trading at Monday's open as key golds rose along with declining fears of U.S. interest rate hikes.

New York climbed in early dealings as investors increasingly decided that the U.S. Federal Reserve was less likely to raise interest rates after recent data showed lackluster U.S. economic growth, traders said.
However market players will be eying this week's slew of numbers. "If the numbers are brutal, they'll trash (the markets)," one trader warned.
All but two of Toronto's 14 sub-indices gained ground, led by golds, transportation, consumer products and oils. Real estate and conglomerates dipped.
Winners outnumbered losers 335 to 201 and 228 traded flat.
* Pure Gold Resources Inc rose 0.03 to 0.52 on nearly three million shares.
* Banks continued to roll higher. Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce added 0.15 to hit 33.60.
